title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 122
description: Ten questions on Psalms 122: gladness at going to Yahweh's house, Jerusalem's gates and thrones, and the call to pray for the peace of Jerusalem.

questions.text: What was the psalmist glad to hear people say to him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:1 says "I was glad when they said to me, 'Let's go to Yahweh's house!'"

questions.text: Where are "our feet" standing, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:2 says "Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem."

answers.text: On the rooftops of your houses, Jerusalem

questions.text: How is Jerusalem described in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:3 says Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together.

answers.text: Built on a high rock beside the great sea
Built as a city that is compact together
A city whose gates never close

questions.text: Who go up to Jerusalem, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:4 says it is where the tribes go up, even Yah's tribes.

answers.text: The armies of the north country

questions.text: Whose thrones are set there for judgment?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:5 says "There are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David's house."

answers.text: The thrones of the house of Levi

questions.text: For what does verse 6 tell us to pray?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:6 says "Pray for the peace of Jerusalem."

questions.text: What will happen to those who love Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:6 says "Those who love you will prosper."

questions.text: Verse 7 wishes peace within your walls and prosperity within your what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:7 says "Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces."

questions.text: For whose sakes does the psalmist say, "Peace be within you"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:8 says "For my brothers' and companions' sakes, I will now say, 'Peace be within you.'"

answers.text: For the king's and the princes' sakes
For his brothers' and companions' sakes
For his sons' and daughters' sakes
For the priests' and Levites' sakes

questions.text: For the sake of what will the psalmist seek Jerusalem's good?
questions.explanation: Psalms 122:9 says "For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good."

answers.text: The fields and vineyards of his family
The house of Yahweh our God
